label: Learning theory
text: CS.O.A4.1 Learning theory — a binary concept class is PAC-learnable if and only if its VC dimension is finite (uses MA.O.A5). No-free-lunch: averaged uniformly over all objective functions, every optimiser performs equally.

warrant.standard: held-out evaluation, stated metric and variance, replication
warrant.defeaters: data leakage, benchmark overfitting, distribution shift
